properties.note: cis(Z)-diimide...ethylene prereaction complex (straight registry, H3...C5 = H4...C6 = 2.41/2.40 A); lowest verified cis-complex minimum, used as the barrier reference.

cis(Z)-diimide...ethylene prereaction-complex conformer reached by the accepted bidirectional IRC: Opt=(Tight) Freq started verbatim from the canonical outer frame irc-...end-b.xyz, 24 modes, 0 imaginary, E = -189.094518735 Ha, H3...C5 = H4...C6 = 2.043 A; degenerate with RC (candA, -189.094518484 Ha) to 0.0002 kcal/mol. The slightly tighter 1.95 A IRC conformer previously bound here is work/ts_cis/ts_annot/end_rc_s20d.log (-189.094517322 Ha) and is kept only as this note.

First-order saddle of the reacting N=N.C=C complex - synchronous, mirror-symmetric Cs structure (H3...C5 1.689, H4...C6 1.688, N1-H3 = N2-H4 1.129, N1=N2 1.197, C5=C6 1.371 A), exactly one imaginary frequency -444.9504 cm-1 (next real 219.99 cm-1) with the coupled N1-H3/N2-H4 breaking and C5-H3/C6-H4 forming eigenvector (forming 3-5 0.871, 4-6 0.864; breaking 1-3 0.422, 2-4 0.413; heavy-atom fraction 0.188). Delivered through the ts_opt + frequency stages of edges step_066d0568 and step_dd49a770; the minimum-type geometry slot is disposed not_applicable (a saddle has no zero-imaginary geometry, dec_f6529a25).

N2...C2H6 product complex (24 modes, 0 imaginary). The product side is additionally representable as separated N2 (work/annotated/n2/n2.log, -109.439973699) + C2H6 (work/annotated/c2h6/c2h6.log, -79.7770350813), 1.38 kcal/mol above this complex; the complex is the declared product node.

Product-side reference of the delivered step (N2 + C2H6, DAG two-component declaration). Single declared energy: the bound N2...C2H6 product complex minimum work/annotated/p_complex.log (normal termination, 0 imaginary, -189.219234176 Ha), which is the equilibrium form of this pair and the same minimum as node P; it is the only energy value declared for this node and the only one used for any comparison. The IRC product direction was verified against the asymptote by the separated minimum structure files cited in the edge notes, not by any combined number.
